summary: IMC Rare Earths Ltd, a Cayman Islands holding company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering. The company sold 4,000,000 ordinary shares at $5.00 per share on a firm commitment basis, with Roberts Ryan, Inc. as representative underwriter. The IPO was registered on Form F-1 and listed on NYSE American under ticker IMC. This is a routine IPO reporting event, not a special situation. No acquisitions, divestitures, or other special categories apply. The filing simply provides the underwriting agreement and press releases regarding pricing and closing.
